resources.string: Retail Mind reads on-screen text from bank and UPI apps only, so the shop can match an incoming payment to a bill. It does not tap, swipe, type, or control other apps. You can keep billing manually if this is off.

Retail Mind is a point-of-sale app. Optional SMS, notification, and accessibility access are used only to detect bank and UPI payment confirmations on this device. Manual billing remains available without them.
